title: Zero-Velocity Lieb–Robinson Bounds for Disordered Spin Systems
exact_target: Can time-uniform locality bounds establish a many-body localized regime for general disordered finite-range spin systems?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003217 (OWR-14751-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems and Effective Theories (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/43, pp. 2465--2511. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 18.
Hamza--Sims--Stolz (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
one-dimensional disordered bounds (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The word general cannot be interpreted as every disorder distribution at every disorder strength: those classes include delocalized systems. A proposed localized regime and quantitative disorder hypotheses require source-specific specification; no unconditional universal theorem is created here.
